{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ambassadorial Commission''' was an executive body within the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. As of [[3956 BBY]], it maintained operations at the [[Sith Embassy]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The [[Ahto City Civil Authority]] charged [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] with [[Death/Legends|murdering]] members of the Ambassadorial Commission after he [[Raid on the Sith Embassy|infiltrated the Embassy]] during his [[Jedi Civil War|quest for the Star Forge]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Arbiter/Legends|Arbiter]] [[Bwa'lass]] mentions this organization by name while listing the crimes Revan had been charged with after the raid on the Sith Embassy.
